data.description:
## Context / Problem
tests/_exe_stub.py (landed in f204965134f for transhuman-wounded-pangolin) is admitted past the mechanism-delta ratchet by a '# mechanism-ok: test_helper' marker, which must name a sunset ticket that retires it (src/rebar/_commands/sunset_markers.py). This ticket is that sunset. The helper builds real <name>.exe launchers (distlib ScriptMaker) so PATH-stubbed tools run on Windows; that is a second process layer per stub and a dev-extra dependency on distlib.

## Retirement path
Tests that stub git, scc, acli or sandbox-exec could intercept the spawn in-process instead, the way tests/interfaces/store/test_repair_pause_ownership_store.py::test_a_slow_local_git_call_does_not_fail_the_repair_pause wraps rebar._store.gitutil._run_in_group. That works where the spawn goes through one rebar seam in the test process; it does not reach child processes (tests/interfaces/metrics_polyglot_support.py runs the CLI as a subprocess; tests/unit/test_repo_isolation_guard.py stubs git for a nested pytest). Retiring the helper therefore needs either a spawn seam those children honour, or a decision that the helper is permanent infrastructure (then close this as wontfix only after repointing or removing the marker).

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] tests/_exe_stub.py and its mechanism-ok marker are removed with every caller ported, and the distlib dev-extra entry is dropped, OR the marker is repointed to a ticket that records a decision to keep the helper.
data.title: Retire tests/_exe_stub.py: intercept tool spawns in-process instead of PATH stubs
